params.script_inline:
import sys, json
doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
d = doc["body"]
envelope = doc["envelope"]
question = envelope.get("header", {}).get("context", {}).get("question", "")
thread = []
if question:
    thread.append({"origin": "user", "type": "text", "text": question})
thread.extend(d.get("messages", []))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"messages": thread}))
